nodes.title: RedNode Studio 1.5
widgets_values:
**RedNode Studio 1.5**

Open **RedNode Start Here Install** from the template browser first and let ComfyUI Manager install what it offers. It holds one node from each pack this workflow can use, so Manager finds them in one pass instead of one at a time. Restart ComfyUI, then open this workflow.

Without that step the graph opens with missing nodes in red.

**What's new in 1.5**

- The tabs moved into a rail down the side, grouped, with icons. Fold it to icons only, drag its edge to resize it, put it on either side. Right-click a tab to switch it on or off or hide it. The preset button at the top picks a set of tabs for the job: Basic, New image, Edit, Paint and more.
- A red **Generate** button sits at the top of the rail. Advanced has an option to jump to the Run page when you press it.
- **Editor** tab: Upscale, Realism, Re-angle, Swap and Converter, with its own source gallery. Edit a picture from the gallery, or render first and edit the new render.
- **Realism** turns an illustration into a photograph.
- **Upscale**, a page on the Editor tab: SeedVR2, VOSR 2.0 or tiled, on one picture or a folder.
- **Hero Creator** makes a clean front-on subject reference out of any photo.
- The **Models** tab has four pages: Model, CLIP, VAE, then Sampling, Seed and Setup. **Setup** builds a rig in one click for Krea 2 Turbo, Z-Image Turbo, Qwen Image 2.1, Anima or SDXL / Illustrious / Pony, finding the files in your folders by name.
- **Seed** page: tie each part of a run to the main seed, a named seed or its own.
- A prompt now renders on whichever rig is active, and each prompt can name its own LoRA set.
- The LoRA stack has a search box.
- **Qwen Image 2.1** runs as a rig, released 20 September and working here from the first week. **Models > Setup** has it as a one-click family: it finds the three files below and sets 25 steps, cfg 1, euler / simple. It renders, paints and details on the Workspace like any other rig. It needs ComfyUI 0.37.0 or newer; everything else in the pack runs on older versions.

**Node packs this workflow needs**

| Pack | What it does here |
| --- | --- |
| [RedNode Studio](https://github.com/RedNodeAI/ComfyUI-RedNodeStudio) | The Workspace, the rigs, the prompt tools, the notes |
| [ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF) | The GGUF text encoder loader on the ZTurbo rig |
| [Krea2-BBOX-Prompter](https://github.com/ukr8b3g-cmyk/Krea2-BBOX-Prompter) | The Light & Color and Scene nodes |
| [ComfyUI-Krea-Moodboards](https://github.com/Andro-Meta/ComfyUI-Krea-Moodboards) | The Style browser |
| [ComfyUI-EulerDiscreteScheduler](https://github.com/erosDiffusion/ComfyUI-EulerDiscreteScheduler) | The FlowMatch scheduler on the ZTurbo rig |
| [Derfuu_ComfyUI_ModdedNodes](https://github.com/Derfuu/Derfuu_ComfyUI_ModdedNodes) | The text node feeding the prompt |

Optional, and only if you switch them on inside the Workspace: the caption engines, the Detailer's and Upscale tab's upscalers and segmenter, and the Post tab's depth and mask models. The Overview tab's **Check installs** button tells you which of those your own settings call for, and links to each. Nothing there is needed to render.

**Model files**

Put each file in the folder named. Then either press the matching family on **Models > Setup**, or pick the files yourself on **Models > Model, CLIP, VAE**. You only need the files for the rigs you use.

*Diffusion models* into `models/diffusion_models`

| File | Used by | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `krea2TurboOfficialComfy_krea2TurboFp8.safetensors` | the Krea2 Raw rig | [Krea 2 Turbo Official Comfy-Org Checkpoints](https://civitai.com/models/2726029/krea-2-turbo-official-comfy-org-checkpoints-krea2), the fp8 file. The same model is in [Comfy-Org/Krea-2](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2) as `krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled` |
| `pornmasterKrea2_v2TurboInt8.safetensors` | the PornMaster Krea2 rig | [on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/Lucas77077/Krea-2-Models/blob/main/pornmasterKrea2_v2TurboInt8.safetensors) |
| `qwen_image_2.1_bf16.safetensors`, or `qwen_image_2.1_int8_convrot.safetensors` for a smaller card | the Qwen 2.1 rig | [Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1) |

The PornMaster file is an INT8 build. If it won't load, set that rig's **Loader** on the Models tab to **INT8 W8A8** and install ComfyUI-INT8-Fast, which the Start Here workflow offers. An INT8 file looks like any other `.safetensors`, so the loader can't tell from the name alone.

*Checkpoints* into `models/checkpoints`

| File | Used by | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| any SDXL, Illustrious, NoobAI or Pony checkpoint | the SDXL / Illustrious rig | the one saved here is `JANKUTrainedChenkinNoobai_v777.safetensors`. Press **SDXL / Illustrious / Pony** on **Models > Setup** and it picks up your own |

*Text encoders* into `models/text_encoders`

| File | Used by | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors` | the Krea2 Raw rig, CLIP type `krea2` | [Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen3-VL/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors) |
| `qwen3VLInstruct4bHeretic_v10.safetensors` | the PornMaster Krea2 rig, CLIP type `krea2` | [Qwen3-VL-4b-Heretic for ComfyUI](https://huggingface.co/DreamFast/Qwen3-VL-4b-Heretic-ComfyUI). Any build in there works; pick one your card fits |
| `qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors` | the Qwen 2.1 rig, CLIP type `qwen_image` | [Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1) |
| `Qwen3-4B-abliterated_dark.safetensors` | the ZTurbo chain, CLIP type `lumina2` | [Huihui Qwen3-4B-abliterated for ComfyUI](https://huggingface.co/AEmotionStudio/Huihui-Qwen3-4B-abliterated-v2-CLIP), from [huihui-ai/Qwen3-4B-abliterated](https://huggingface.co/huihui-ai/Qwen3-4B-abliterated) |

*VAEs* into `models/vae`

| File | Used by | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `qwen_image_vae.safetensors` | both Krea 2 rigs | [Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/blob/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors) |
| `qwen_image_2.1_vae_bf16.safetensors` | the Qwen 2.1 rig | [Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1). Qwen 2.1 only: it does not work on Krea 2 |
| `UltraFlux.safetensors` | the ZTurbo chain | [UltraFlux VAE](https://civitai.com/models/2231253/ultraflux-vae-or-improved-quality-for-flux-and-zimage) |

Qwen Image 2.1 ships under Alibaba's Qwen research licence: free for personal and research use, not for commercial work without their say.

**The rigs**

Six rigs live on the Models tab. One is active at a time and renders. **Krea2 Raw** is the active one when this opens.

- **Krea2 Raw**: the official Krea 2 Turbo from its own files. 8 steps, cfg 1, euler / simple.
- **PornMaster Krea2**: a Krea 2 Turbo merge from its own files, the INT8 build. 8 steps, cfg 1, euler / simple.
- **Qwen 2.1**: Qwen Image 2.1 from its own files. 25 steps, cfg 1, euler / simple. Needs ComfyUI 0.37.0 or newer.
- **Krea2 External**: Your own nodes, running through the `krea2_external` chain on the canvas. Marked as the official Krea 2 Turbo, which is what the identity edit wants.
- **ZTurbo**: Your own nodes, running through the `ZTurbo` chain. 12 steps, cfg 1, euler / simple, with the FlowMatch scheduler and a split sigma pair.
- **SDXL / Illustrious**: one checkpoint file. 28 steps, cfg 6, dpmpp_2m / karras.

A rig set to **Your own nodes** is driven by the **Built-in sampler**. That sounds backwards and it's worth reading twice: your own sampler does the work, and the Workspace hands it the prompts, the latent, the seed and the numbers through Rig Inputs, then takes the picture back from Rig Result. On **External sampler** the Workspace renders nothing at all and those rigs never run.

The `rig3` chain, in the group marked PLUG YOUR OWN RIG HERE, is an empty slot for your own sampler. Name a rig after it on the Models tab, set that rig to Your own nodes, and it runs.

**Hold two rigs** on the Models tab is off. Turn it on only if you switch between two rigs every run and have the system RAM for both.

**Using it**

1. Pick the rig on the **Models** tab, or build one on **Models > Setup**.
2. Write the prompt on the **Prompts** tab. It renders on whichever rig is active. Pick a LoRA set on the row if that prompt wants different LoRAs.
3. Press **Generate** at the top of the rail, or on the Run tab, and watch the stages, the picture and the memory.
4. The **Overview** tab maps the whole run in the order it happens: green is on, grey is off, amber is on but stood aside, red wants fixing. Hover a box for the reason, click one to open the page that decides it.

Nothing is saved unless **Save** is switched on, on the Run tab. The finished picture still shows in the Live picture and the Review either way.

**VRAM**

Set **VRAM limit** on the Run tab to your card. The line under it says what the run needs with nothing held, and whether it will hold to stay under the limit. Holding is slower but keeps a big rig inside a small card. On a card with room to spare, Free range is faster.

A rig built from your own nodes

1. Your loaders go into Rig Model. Wire its model into your sampler. The Workspace adds this rig's LoRAs and camera LoRAs to it for you.
2. Rig Inputs hands your sampler the prompts, latent, seed, steps, CFG, sampler, scheduler and denoise from the Workspace.
3. Your sampler's latent goes into Rig Result.

On the Workspace, the Models tab has a rig named My rig of kind Your own nodes. Type your prompt on the Prompts tab and queue. There are no wires to the Workspace: the three rig nodes find it by the rig name. Swap the KSampler for any sampler you like.
